note: Fiji: citizens of the countries on Fiji Immigration's list need no visa and are given a visitor permit on immigration clearance for up to 4 months (extendable by 2, not modelled); everyone else needs a visa before travel, applied for online. Read on 2026-11-03 from the Ministry of Immigration's own pages, which confirmed Wikipedia's copy, read before, and added Sierra Leone, which it had left out (Bermuda's and the Cook Islands' passports are their states' here).

sources.title: Ministry of Immigration, Republic of Fiji: Visa exempted countries
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries are not required to obtain a Fiji visa when travelling to Fiji. However, these travellers will still need the relevant permits depending on the nature of their travel ... Americas and Caribbean ... Venezuela ... Europe ... Asia, Oceania, and the Pacific ... Sierra Leone ... Zimbabwe

sources.title: Ministry of Immigration, Republic of Fiji: Visit Fiji
sources.said: Others will be given visitor permits on Immigration Clearance. This visitor permit will allow a visitor up to 4 months of stay. The stay can further be extended to 2 months if applying for extension and the fee is paid.
